name: meadow
description: Language support for Meadow: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, rename and inlay hints.

meadow.server.path.description: Path to the `meadow` executable; the extension runs `meadow lsp`. Left at `meadow`, it searches your PATH first, then $MEADOW_HOME/bin, ~/.cargo/bin and ~/.meadow/bin — an editor launched from the Dock or the Start menu does not inherit your shell PATH. Whatever it finds is asked whether it understands `lsp` before being used.

meadow.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred types after parameters and `let` bindings.

meadow.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the language server.
